cities.line: Well we holler and we burn down cities
stanza: Born shiny bullets in an army of ants
Blow that horn, we sleep in our pants
Well we holler and we burn down cities
We'll fight for your music halls
They'll fight for your neural walls

cities.line: We both wake in lonely beds, different cities
stanza: In dreams, I meet you in warm conversation
We both wake in lonely beds, different cities
And time is taking its sweet time erasing you
And you've got your demons, and darling, they all look like me
